name: gizza-ai/shell-command-parser
summary: Parse shell commands into JSON, trees, explanations, or command tables.

tool.description: Parses a POSIX/bash-style shell command line into commands, pipes, redirects, assignments, quotes, globs, and expansions without executing anything.

format.description: Output format: structured JSON, an ASCII tree, a plain-English explanation, or a flat command table.

input.description: Shell command line to parse. The command is analyzed only; it is never executed.

pretty.description: Pretty-print JSON output with indentation. Ignored by non-JSON formats.
